title: ubuntu/devel → ubuntu/devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 9bdad29..86e3bfe 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
+openjdk-17 (17.0.15+6~us1-0ubuntu1) plucky; urgency=medium
+
+  * OpenJDK 17.0.15 release, build 6. Release notes:
+    https://mail.openjdk.org/pipermail/jdk-updates-dev/2025-April/043307.html
+
+    - CVEs:
+      + CVE-2025-21587
+      + CVE-2025-30691
+      + CVE-2025-30698
+
+  [ Matthias Klose ]
+  * Honour DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS=parallel=N while running jtreg tests (Helmut
+    Grohne). Addresses: #1095920.
+
+ -- Pushkar Kulkarni <pushkar.kulkarni@canonical.com>  Thu, 17 Apr 2025 11:54:53 +0530
+
 openjdk-17 (17.0.15~5ea-1) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * OpenJDK 17.0.14 early access, build 5.

index a840290..e49ee62 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -83,7 +83,7 @@ else
 endif
 
 is_upstream_release = yes
-is_upstream_release =
+#is_upstream_release =
 
 srcdir		= .
 builddir	= build
@@ -1997,7 +1997,7 @@ endif
 	dh_builddeb -a $(nodemo) $(nojrez) #$(bd_options)
 
 git_project		= jdk17u
-git_tag			= jdk-17.0.15+5
+git_tag			= jdk-17.0.15+6

diff --git a/debian/tests/jtreg-autopkgtest.in b/debian/tests/jtreg-autopkgtest.in
index 41194c9..040649e 100755
--- a/debian/tests/jtreg-autopkgtest.in
+++ b/debian/tests/jtreg-autopkgtest.in
@@ -30,7 +30,13 @@ if [[ "armel" == *"${host_arch}"* ]]; then
   jt_options+=" -Xmx256M"
 fi
 if dpkg --compare-versions ${jtreg_version} ge 4.2; then
-  jt_options+=" -conc:auto"
+  njobs=auto
+  for opt in ${DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS:-}; do
+    if test "${opt#parallel=}" != "$opt"; then
+      njobs="${opt#parallel=}"
+    fi
+  done
+  jt_options+=" -conc:$njobs"
 fi
 
 # check java binary
